label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Hiya all,

Right, big news, and it's a secret so keep it zipped! Morag at the salon has said I can have Hair by Morag to myself on the Saturday afternoon before Gran's 80th, so I'm going to do all your hair for free before we head out for her dinner. Brilliant, eh?

The plan is Saturday 12th December from 1pm. Morag closes at 12 that day, so we'll have the place to ourselves. Dinner's booked for 8.30 at the Italian on Byres Rd, table for nine, so there's plenty of time to get sorted first.

Who's in: me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Ava and Ruby, and Gran, so that's seven heads. Gran doesn't know yet, so please don't let it slip when you speak to her!

Cut and blow-dry is sorted for everyone. If you want colour, I need to know by Friday 27th November so I can order from the wholesaler. Mum, Gran said at Easter she'd love to go silver properly but won't pay salon prices, so I'm hoping you can talk her into it. Linda, I'm not doing your colour in your kitchen again after last time. You, the cooker and the dog are still scarred. So colour only if you tell me in time, and it'll be done properly in the salon.

Ava and Ruby, you can have wee braids and glitter spray. I know you'll love it.

Mum, you're the best bet to get Gran there for 1 without telling her why. Think of a good excuse, you're the expert.

Bring a bottle of fizz. Morag says that's fine as long as we tidy up after ourselves, so we're on our best behaviour.

Text me back with what you want by Friday 27th, colours or not. Can't wait!

Speak soon,
[Your name]
